extracted.intended_audience: members of the public, stakeholders, and practitioners who track Federal Register public-inspection documents and upcoming notices (e.g., regulatory attorneys, agency staff, and notice-and-comment participants)
extracted.subtask_description: A daily public-inspection index page listing Federal Register documents (notices, rules, meetings, proposed rules, guidance, etc.) with metadata (agency, title, document number, PDF URL, raw text URL, subjects, page counts, and publication dates). Useful for locating documents to review or comment on.
